    <h1 class="devsite-page-title" tabindex="-1">
      Using files<devsite-actions hidden data-nosnippet>
    <devsite-llm-tools></devsite-llm-tools></devsite-actions>
  
      
    </h1>
  <div class="devsite-page-title-meta"><devsite-view-release-notes></devsite-view-release-notes></div>

    depth="2"
    devsite-toc-embedded
    >
  </devsite-toc>
  
    
  <div class="devsite-article-body clearfix
  ">

  
    
    <p>The Gemini API supports uploading media files separately from the prompt input, allowing your media to be reused across multiple requests and multiple prompts. For more details, check out the <a href="https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/prompting_with_media">Prompting with media</a> guide.</p>
<div itemscope="" itemtype="http://developers.google.com/ReferenceObject"><h2 id="rest-resource:-files" data-text="REST Resource: files" tabindex="-1">REST Resource: files</h2><a name="v1beta.files"></a>
<meta content="files" itemprop="name"/>
<meta content="/api/rest/v1beta/files" itemprop="path"/>

</ul>

</ul>
<section class="prototype" id="File">
<h2 id="File" data-text="Resource: File" tabindex="-1">Resource: File</h2>
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<section id="File.description">
<p>A file uploaded to the API. </p>
</section>
<section id="File.FIELDS">
<thead>
<tr>
<th colspan="2">Fields</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<section id="File.FIELDS.name">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">name</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Immutable. Identifier. The <code translate="no" dir="ltr">File</code> resource name. The ID (name excluding the "files/" prefix) can contain up to 40 characters that are lowercase alphanumeric or dashes (-). The ID cannot start or end with a dash. If the name is empty on create, a unique name will be generated. Example: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">files/123-456</code></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="File.FIELDS.display_name">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">displayName</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. The human-readable display name for the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">File</code>. The display name must be no more than 512 characters in length, including spaces. Example: "Welcome Image"</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="File.FIELDS.mime_type">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">mimeType</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Output only. MIME type of the file.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="File.FIELDS.size_bytes">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">sizeBytes</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string (<a href="https://developers.google.com/discovery/v1/type-format">int64</a> format)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Output only. Size of the file in bytes.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="File.FIELDS.create_time">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">createTime</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="https://protobuf.dev/reference/protobuf/google.protobuf/#timestamp">Timestamp</a></code> format)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Output only. The timestamp of when the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">File</code> was created.</p><p>Uses RFC 3339, where generated output will always be Z-normalized and use 0, 3, 6 or 9 fractional digits. Offsets other than "Z" are also accepted. Examples: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23Z"</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z"</code> or <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23+05:30"</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="File.FIELDS.update_time">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">updateTime</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="https://protobuf.dev/reference/protobuf/google.protobuf/#timestamp">Timestamp</a></code> format)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Output only. The timestamp of when the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">File</code> was last updated.</p><p>Uses RFC 3339, where generated output will always be Z-normalized and use 0, 3, 6 or 9 fractional digits. Offsets other than "Z" are also accepted. Examples: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23Z"</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z"</code> or <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23+05:30"</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="File.FIELDS.expiration_time">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">expirationTime</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="https://protobuf.dev/reference/protobuf/google.protobuf/#timestamp">Timestamp</a></code> format)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Output only. The timestamp of when the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">File</code> will be deleted. Only set if the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">File</code> is scheduled to expire.</p><p>Uses RFC 3339, where generated output will always be Z-normalized and use 0, 3, 6 or 9 fractional digits. Offsets other than "Z" are also accepted. Examples: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23Z"</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z"</code> or <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23+05:30"</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="File.FIELDS.sha256_hash">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">sha256Hash</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string (<a href="https://developers.google.com/discovery/v1/type-format">bytes</a> format)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Output only. SHA-256 hash of the uploaded bytes.</p><p>A base64-encoded string.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="File.FIELDS.uri">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">uri</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Output only. The uri of the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">File</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="File.FIELDS.download_uri">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">downloadUri</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Output only. The download uri of the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">File</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="File.FIELDS.state">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">state</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">enum (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/files#State">State</a></code>)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Output only. Processing state of the File.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="File.FIELDS.source">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">source</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">enum (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/files#Source">Source</a></code>)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Source of the File.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="File.FIELDS.error">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">error</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">object (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/files#v1beta.Status">Status</a></code>)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Output only. Error status if File processing failed.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<div class="field-entry union-type">
<div class="signature">
<tr class="alt" id="File.FIELDS.metadata">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">metadata</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">Union type</code>
</span>
</tr>
<div class="union-type-preamble">
<div>Metadata for the File. The following is a list of mutually exclusive fields. At most one of the fields will be set in a response:</div>
<section id="File.FIELDS.video_metadata">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">videoMetadata</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">object (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/files#VideoFileMetadata">VideoFileMetadata</a></code>)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Output only. Metadata for a video.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<div>End of mutually exclusive fields.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
<div class="second-column">

<section id="google.ai.generativelanguage.v1beta.FileService.ListFiles">
</section>
<section id="description">
<p>Lists the metadata for <code translate="no" dir="ltr">File</code>s owned by the requesting project.</p>
</section>
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<section id="body.HTTP_TEMPLATE">

<span class="http-method">
                get
              </span>
<span class="endpoint-url">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">https:<wbr/>/<wbr/>/generativelanguage.googleapis.com<wbr/>/v1beta<wbr/>/files</code>

<span>

</span>

<section id="body.QUERY_PARAMETERS">

<section id="body.QUERY_PARAMETERS.page_size">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">pageSize</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">integer</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. Maximum number of <code translate="no" dir="ltr">File</code>s to return per page. If unspecified, defaults to 10. Maximum <code translate="no" dir="ltr">pageSize</code> is 100.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="body.QUERY_PARAMETERS.page_token">

</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. A page token from a previous <code translate="no" dir="ltr">files.list</code> call.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<section id="google.ai.generativelanguage.v1beta.FileService.RegisterFiles">
</section>
<section id="description">
<p>Registers a Google Cloud Storage files with FileService. The user is expected to provide Google Cloud Storage URIs and will receive a File resource for each URI in return. Note that the files are not copied, just registered with File API. If one file fails to register, the whole request fails.</p>
</section>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Upload the actual bytes.</span>
curl<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">${</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">upload_url</span><span class="devsite-syntax-si">}</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-se">\</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-nb">echo</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">file_uri</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$file_uri</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-nv">state</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">$(</span>jq<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">".file.state"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>file_info.json<span class="devsite-syntax-k">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-nb">echo</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">state</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$state</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Ensure the state of the video is 'ACTIVE'</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-k">while</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">[[</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"(</span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$state</span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">)"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>*<span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"PROCESSING"</span>*<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">]]</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">;</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-k">do</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nb">echo</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Processing video..."</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>sleep<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-m">5</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Get the file of interest to check state</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span>curl<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/files/<span class="devsite-syntax-nv">$name</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> &gt; </span>file_info.json
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nv">state</span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span><span class="devsite-syntax-k">$(</span>jq<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">".file.state"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>file_info.json<span class="devsite-syntax-k">)</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-k">done</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-c1"># Now generate content using that file</span>

cat<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span>response.json
<span class="devsite-syntax-nb">echo</span>

</div><div itemscope="" itemtype="http://developers.google.com/ReferenceObject"><h2 id="status" data-text="Status" tabindex="-1">Status</h2><a name="v1beta.Status"></a>
<meta content="Status" itemprop="name"/>
<meta content="/api/rest/v1beta/Status" itemprop="path"/>
<section class="prototype" id="/api/rest/v1beta/Status">
<ul class="toc">
<li><a href="#SCHEMA_REPRESENTATION">JSON representation</a></li>
</ul>
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<section id="description">
<p>The <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Status</code> type defines a logical error model that is suitable for different programming environments, including REST APIs and RPC APIs. It is used by <a href="https://github.com/grpc">gRPC</a>. Each <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Status</code> message contains three pieces of data: error code, error message, and error details.</p><p>You can find out more about this error model and how to work with it in the <a href="https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/errors">API Design Guide</a>.</p>
</section>
<section id="FIELDS">
<thead>
<tr>
<th colspan="2">Fields</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<section id="FIELDS.code">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">code</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">integer</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The status code, which should be an enum value of <code translate="no" dir="ltr">google.rpc.Code</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="FIELDS.message">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">message</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the <code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/files#FIELDS.details">google.rpc.Status.details</a></code> field, or localized by the client.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="FIELDS.details">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">details[]</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">object</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>A list of messages that carry the error details. There is a common set of message types for APIs to use.</p><p>An object containing fields of an arbitrary type. An additional field <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"@type"</code> contains a URI identifying the type. Example: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">{ "id": 1234, "@type": "types.example.com/standard/id" }</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
